cues: Succinyl coenzyme A gives one ATP directly.
Succinate is oxidised to fumarate, making FADH two.
Fumarate becomes malate, and malate is oxidised back to oxaloacetate, making a third NADH.
The cycle is ready for the next acetyl group.
